error_abort_degraded_demo.description: Synthetic examples of error, abort, and degraded states for UI testing. These do NOT represent actual system states.

scenarios.title: Data Source Timeout
scenarios.detail: Primary OHLCV data source timed out after 30 seconds. Retry 1/3 failed. Fallback to secondary source triggered.

scenarios.title: Factor Library Hash Mismatch
scenarios.detail: Computed FactorLib hash does not match sealed hash. Possible unauthorized modification detected.

scenarios.title: Event Store Write Failure
scenarios.detail: Disk write failure on EventStore partition. 3 events queued in memory buffer.

scenarios.title: Macro Veto Triggered
scenarios.detail: L2.5 MacroVeto: VIX spike >30 detected. All intraday operations halted per policy L2.5-ABORT-01.

scenarios.title: Concurrent Run Conflict
scenarios.detail: Another Z-G14 run (RUN-2026-06-12-0200) still in progress. Aborting duplicate per singleton policy.

scenarios.title: Schema Version Mismatch
scenarios.detail: Deployed schema v2.9.5 vs expected v2.9.6-draft. Rollback or migration required.

scenarios.title: Hermes Memory Kernel Blocked
scenarios.detail: Knowledge graph persistence unavailable due to schema migration. Events buffered in EventStore. No data loss.
scenarios.impact: Memory recall delayed until migration completes

scenarios.title: Z9 Calibration Stale
scenarios.detail: Calibration samples older than 48 hours. Confidence intervals widened from [0.68,0.81] to [0.59,0.86].
scenarios.impact: Decision gate uses relaxed confidence thresholds

scenarios.title: R-Matrix Partial Coverage
scenarios.detail: Real Estate sector (SW 3/31) excluded from R-Matrix due to insufficient oscillation patterns. 60/63 stocks processed.
scenarios.impact: RE sector stocks unavailable for oscillation ranking
